name: publicWeb_getRunPhotos
description: Returns the publicly visible photos of a run (audience model Status >= 3: Public 3 and Cover 5), identified by its public event UUID. Used by the mobile guest gallery and the public website. Unauthenticated — no auth parameters, no permission gate. GPS coordinates are deliberately not returned (M15 privacy fix; pins come from publicWeb_getRunPhotoPins). The display URL is the Hash Flash edit when one exists, else the original. Rowset 0 is an event-existence sentinel (0 rows = event not found, the shim returns 404); rowset 1 is the photos, oldest first. A NULL or all-zero id short-circuits with { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } before the TRY block.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run's public-facing UUID (HC.Event.PublicEventId), not the internal Event.id. NULL or the zero UUID returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage = '@publicEventId is required' }. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Only when @publicEventId is NULL or the zero UUID; the only rowset returned in that case.

rowsets.name: EventExistence
rowsets.description: TOP 1 row { EventFound: 1 } when an HC.Event has this PublicEventId (no deleted/removed filter). 0 rows when not found — the shim turns that into a 404.

columns.name: EventFound
columns.description: Always 1; 0 rows means event not found.

rowsets.name: Photos
rowsets.description: Photos with Status >= 3 and DeletedAt IS NULL for the event, joined to the uploader, ordered by CreatedAt ASC. May be empty. GPS coordinates are intentionally excluded.

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: Display URL: COALESCE(NULLIF(EditedBlobUrl, ''), BlobUrl) — the crop when there is one, else the original (same rule as the app).

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.CreatedAt — UTC upload time; the sort key.

columns.name: uploaderDisplayName
columns.description: HC.Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column, never NULL — falls back to '<no names provided>').

codeSmells.issue: KennelPhotos.Status is TINYINT in the table
codeSmells.detail: HC.KennelPhotos.Status is TINYINT NOT NULL, against the project's SMALLINT convention. The filter kp.Status >= 3 (line 54) works by implicit conversion; any parameter mapped to this column should be SMALLINT. The table file's comment ('0 private, 1 pending, 2 public') is stale against the audience model the SP uses (3 Public, 5 Cover).

Rowset 0 (lines 35-37) and the photo join (line 52) match on PublicEventId only, so a deleted or removed run still reports EventFound = 1 and its public photos remain visible. Possibly intended, but undocumented.

codeSmells.issue: Validation error uses a different envelope from the success shape
codeSmells.detail: Lines 24-28 return { Success, ErrorMessage } as rowset 0 for a missing id, where the success path's rowset 0 is { EventFound }. Callers must check column names to tell them apart. The check also sits outside TRY, which is fine because it cannot fail.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 equivalent. First introduced for HC6 KennelPhotos feature.

2026-06-06 update: parameter renamed from @eventId (internal Event.id lookup) to @publicEventId (Event.PublicEventId lookup). Any caller using the earlier version must be updated to pass PublicEventId instead of the internal id.
